tier_reason: Tier stays C (first-party screenshots). Enricher found the comparison is not like for like: LLRT deploys v3-lib.mjs while the Node 20 functions run v3.mjs or v3-mono.mjs, the load generator is not in the repo, and the cold start includes LLRT-only precompiled zstd bytecode and TLS warmup; an independent user report (issue #1166) puts the gap at about 1.5-2.5x.

corrections.claimed_speedup: README screenshots (2024-01-31): p50 Lambda cold start 64.16 ms vs 1511.93 ms, HTTP round trip 235.61 vs 1719.00 ms against Node 20; not like for like (see caveats). Independent user report, issue #1166: LLRT v0.7.0-beta at 128 MB p50 HTTP 275 ms vs Node 22 at 512 MB 409-681 ms (about 1.5-2.5x). ahaoboy CI v8-v7 throughput: LLRT 972 vs Node 40333 on ubuntu (about 41x lower).
corrections.caveats: Cold-start-only win from vendor screenshots never refreshed since 2024-01-31; the LLRT function runs v3-lib.mjs while the Node 20 functions run v3.mjs or v3-mono.mjs (example/infrastructure/src/index.ts), the load generator is not published, and LLRT precompiles the SDK to zstd bytecode and warms TLS by default. Engine is quickjs-ng via rquickjs 0.14 (no JIT): throughput about 41x below Node on ahaoboy CI. Experimental, not Node-compatible.
